what: A workspace member's build.rs was never seen: the sweep's listing filter handed the layout only lib.rs and main.rs of a package folder, so blaze-manifest's `RawBuild::Auto` never found build.rs and the unit graph had no build-script unit. A fetched package's layout is read from its pack listing, unfiltered, so dependencies' scripts ran. The test that would have shown it had been red on green for a day and its fixture had also gone stale (no `wasm-sha256` in the module record; every check now ends 'incomplete: NOT checked: borrows', so a test that asserts exit 0 fails).
cost: about thirty minutes: two runs to see the real output, then the filter
cause: two readers of a directory (the checkout's filtered sweep, the pack's unfiltered listing) with the filter's list of wanted names kept apart from the layout's list of names it reads
class: a filter that must list what another component reads, kept by hand
prevention: owed: the layout should export the file names it reads in a package folder (lib.rs, main.rs, build.rs) and `wanted` take that list, so the two cannot drift
annoyance: a test red on green is invisible until a lane asks for it
workaround: build.rs added to `wanted`; fixture writes the module's digest; tests read the '0 errors' line instead of the status
